Welcome to Kearney County
Official Website of Kearney County in Nebraska. Your source for Information about Kearney County Offices, Departments and Services.
Cities and villages include Minden, Axtell, Wilcox, Heartwell, Norman, Lowell, Keene and Newark
Announcements
The driver’s licensing office will be open on Wednesdays from 9 am- 4:30 PM in the first floor Assembly Room beginning on Wednesday, August 6, 2025.
